title: Fix Admin Lockout, Restore Login Screen, Fix Save Buttons, Remove Coming Soon Placeholders

requirements.summary: Reset admin authentication to allow default credentials and bypass lockout by modifying AdminGuard to grant access when no session exists, and ensure AdminLoginPage writes a valid session to localStorage/sessionStorage
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /admin no longer shows 'Unauthorized' or 'Actor not available' errors
A valid session written by AdminLoginPage is recognized by AdminGuard without redirect loop
Default credentials (admin / admin123) successfully log in and create a session

file_operations.description: Modify the session validation logic to grant full admin access by default when no valid session exists in localStorage or sessionStorage. Update the getAdminSession helper to return a default admin session object if neither storage contains a valid session, effectively bypassing the lockout. Ensure this temporary bypass can be toggled via a flag or removed once credentials are reset.

Reset the hardcoded credentials to username: 'admin' and password: 'admin123'. Verify that the session creation logic correctly writes a session object to localStorage (or sessionStorage if 'remember me' is unchecked) with all required fields that AdminGuard expects. Ensure the session structure matches what AdminGuard.getAdminSession() validates.

requirements.summary: Rebuild the admin login page to always display Username and Password input fields, ensure the /login route is publicly accessible without AdminGuard, and verify that /admin routes correctly redirect unauthenticated users to login
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting /admin or any /admin/* route while unauthenticated redirects to the login page
The login page renders a Username field, Password field, and a Submit button
Submitting correct credentials grants access to the admin dashboard
Submitting incorrect credentials shows an error message and does not grant access
The login page is never wrapped in AdminGuard and is always accessible

file_operations.description: Ensure the login form always renders Username and Password input fields (controlled inputs) along with a Submit button and optional 'remember me' checkbox. Add form validation to display error messages for empty fields or incorrect credentials. On successful login, store the session and redirect to /admin. The page must not perform any AdminGuard checks itself.

Verify that the /login route is defined without any AdminGuard wrapper, making it publicly accessible. Ensure all /admin and /admin/* routes (except /login) are wrapped with AdminGuard so unauthenticated users are redirected to /login. Confirm TanStack Router route configuration allows the login page to always be reachable.

Ensure AdminGuard redirects to /login (or the correct login route path) when no valid session is found. Verify the redirect logic does not create a loop if the login page is accessed directly. Update any hardcoded redirect paths to match the actual login route in App.tsx.

requirements.summary: Fix backend actor availability issues causing 'Actor not available' and 'Unauthorized' errors on settings save buttons by ensuring mutations wait for the actor and handle null gracefully
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking Save on the UPI ID field in AdminSettingsPage saves the value without showing 'Unauthorized'
Clicking Save on the Shop Status toggle in AdminPage/ShopStatusToggle saves without showing 'Unauthorized'
No 'Actor not available' error is thrown when mutations are invoked
Settings changes persist and are reflected after page reload

file_operations.description: For all mutations that write settings (useSetUpiId, useSetShopStatus, useSetSlogan), add actor availability checks before executing. Ensure each mutation waits for the actor to be non-null and throws or returns a clear error message if the actor remains unavailable. Verify the mutation callbacks handle errors gracefully and pass them to the UI for display.

Ensure the UPI ID save button and slogan save button are disabled while the corresponding mutation is pending or the actor is not available. Display mutation errors (including 'Actor not available' or 'Unauthorized') in toast notifications or inline error messages. Verify that successful saves trigger a success notification and invalidate the relevant query cache.

Ensure the shop status toggle is disabled while the mutation is pending or the actor is unavailable. Display mutation errors (including 'Actor not available' or 'Unauthorized') in an alert or toast. Verify that successful toggles trigger a success notification and invalidate the shop status query cache.

requirements.summary: Remove all 'Coming Soon' placeholders from SearchPage, WalletPage, and MyOrdersPage, and replace them with functional implementations for product search, wallet/cashback display, and order history
acceptanceCriteria: SearchPage no longer shows a 'Coming Soon' message; it shows a working search input and results
Typing in SearchPage filters and displays matching products
WalletPage no longer shows a 'Coming Soon' message; it shows a wallet/cashback UI with real or zero-state data
MyOrdersPage no longer shows a 'Coming Soon' message; it shows order history or an empty-state if no orders exist
BottomNavBar Search and Wallet links navigate to the functional pages

file_operations.description: Remove the 'Coming Soon' placeholder. Implement a search input field that filters products fetched from the backend by name or category. Use the useGetAllProducts query from useQueries.ts to fetch products, then filter the results client-side based on the search input value. Display matching products using the ProductCard component in a grid layout. Show a loading skeleton while fetching and an empty-state message if no products match the search.

Remove the 'Coming Soon' placeholder. Implement a wallet/cashback UI that displays the user's wallet balance (defaulting to 0 if no backend support exists). If the backend does not yet support wallet data, display a static zero balance and a message indicating 'No transactions yet'. Use a card layout with a prominent balance display and a placeholder section for future transaction history. Ensure the page is responsive and matches the app's visual style.

Remove the 'Coming Soon' placeholder. Implement an order history view that fetches the current user's past orders from the backend. If the backend does not expose a user-specific order query, display a message indicating 'Order history is not yet available' or fetch all orders and filter client-side (noting this is not secure for production). Display each order in a card or list item showing order ID, timestamp, status, total price, and a link to view details. Show a loading skeleton while fetching and an empty-state message if no orders exist.

Verify that the Search and Wallet navigation links point to the correct routes (/search and /wallet) and that these routes are registered in App.tsx. Ensure the active route highlighting works correctly for these pages. No changes needed if links are already correct; otherwise, update the href or to prop for the Search and Wallet nav items.
